scope: Skills SDK pipeline and Skill Factory hardening

evidence_sources.query: Skills SDK, Skill Factory, Tessl, scenario, security, stale handle
collector availability and canonical evidence-root pattern
validated recurring steering and stale runtime-handle rows

patterns.pattern: Skill-local contracts can duplicate or redefine the SDK gold rubric.
patterns.ratchet: Require rubric_profile skills-sdk.gold-standard.v1 and keep local criteria to selector or domain additions.

patterns.pattern: KnowledgeOS capsule exports can drift between top-level references and nested knowledge-capsules directories.
patterns.ratchet: Require flat references/*.md capsule paths for new or touched packages; allow references/knowledge-capsules/ only when the manifest includes an explicit migration justification.

patterns.pattern: Reference and capsule files can be present and routed while carrying generic or filename-misaligned headings that agents cannot invoke reliably.
patterns.ratchet: Require every Markdown reference and vendored KnowledgeOS capsule body to pass reference_heading_invocable before OSS, Tessl, or registry movement.

patterns.pattern: Managed YAML and fallback parsers can disagree on scenario count, nested lists, or deterministic checks.
patterns.ratchet: Validate parser parity and avoid alias-dependent deterministic_checks in release scenarios.

patterns.pattern: Package-management references leak into always-loaded SKILL.md progressive disclosure.
patterns.ratchet: Route package-only references through references/contract.yaml and keep SKILL.md coaching/runtime facing.

patterns.pattern: Tessl review, dry-run, live eval, and score receipts are easy to collapse into one score claim.
patterns.ratchet: Require Tessl artifacts to name their lane before they are used as evidence.

patterns.pattern: Skill Factory create, install, build, refactor, or skillify lanes can produce a skill without the same SDK gate ladder.
patterns.ratchet: Require package verify, scenario-quality, and security risk-mode commands in SDK candidate contracts.

patterns.pattern: Security risk review is still easier to treat as optional or external to skill package validation.
patterns.ratchet: Add non-mutating SDK security risk-mode preview before Tessl movement and promote reusable security scripts into SDK validation surfaces.

patterns.pattern: Scenario warnings and weak release cases can be carried into later paid or external lanes.
patterns.ratchet: Release cases need executable acceptance and deterministic checks before promotion.

patterns.pattern: Assistant turns repeatedly probe stale or fabricated wait handles after compaction or heartbeat recovery.
patterns.ratchet: Continue direct-command-only recovery after a stale handle and validate steering uptake plus no-command-handle artifacts.

security_note.codex_security_plugin: Use Codex Security for threat modeling or scoped scans when skill/plugin changes affect command execution, package ingestion, dependency scanning, credentials, external inputs, or registry distribution.
security_note.sdk_position: Security scripts such as OpenClaw-style skill guards should be promoted into Skills SDK validation when they are reusable, deterministic, and package-shape aware.
